headline: Egypt Annual Inflation Slows to 12.0% in October
summary: Egypt's yearly inflation rate decelerated to 12.0% in October, although housing and transport costs continued to rise by over 22%.
why: Consumer price index trends dictate central bank monetary policy stances and influence real yields on local currency debt instruments.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Slowing headline inflation indicates easing price pressures across the domestic economy.
